tool_schemas.name: download_markdown
tool_schemas.description: Downloads the content at the provided `url` via r.jina.ai, converts it to Markdown, saves it under the configured download root (optionally within the specified managed `subdirectory`), and returns the saved file’s details plus an audit record of the download. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing/invalid or `subdirectory` is not a valid managed name, FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, NOT_FOUND if the requested `subdirectory` does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when download limits are enforced. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when r.jina.ai cannot fetch/convert the page and CONFLICT if the service cannot safely write the output due to an existing incompatible path.

url.description: URL of the webpage to download

subdirectory.description: Optional subdirectory to save the file in

tool_schemas.name: list_downloaded_files
tool_schemas.description: Returns the stored download history as a list of downloaded Markdown files, optionally filtered to a single managed `subdirectory`; results are returned as a single unpaged collection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `subdirectory` is not a valid name and NOT_FOUND if the specified `subdirectory` does not exist. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when list/read limits are enforced.

subdirectory.description: Optional subdirectory to list files from

tool_schemas.name: set_download_directory
tool_schemas.description: Sets or replaces the root download directory used for all Markdown saves and subdirectory management, and returns the updated configuration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `directory` is empty or not a valid path string, and CONFLICT if the directory cannot be used because it is incompatible with the existing configuration/state. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not allowed to change configuration and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when configuration updates are rate-limited.

directory.description: Full path to the download directory

tool_schemas.name: get_download_directory
tool_schemas.description: Returns the currently configured root download directory. Raises NOT_FOUND if no download directory has been configured yet. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not allowed to view configuration and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when reads are rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: create_subdirectory
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new managed subdirectory under the configured download root and returns the created subdirectory record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `name` is empty/invalid, FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, and CONFLICT if a subdirectory with the same name already exists or the name collides with an existing non-directory path. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller is not allowed to create subdirectories and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when creation is rate-limited.

name.description: Name of the subdirectory to create

tool_schemas.name: list_subdirectories
tool_schemas.description: Lists managed subdirectories under the currently active download settings. Results are paged and may be filtered by lifecycle `status`. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured/available, PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot view configuration, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when reads are rate-limited.

page_size.description: Maximum number of subdirectories to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_subdirectory
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single managed subdirectory by `id` under the active download settings. Returns the subdirectory record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not visible under the active settings), FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot view configuration.

id.description: Primary key of the subdirectory to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: archive_subdirectory
tool_schemas.description: Archives a managed subdirectory by `id`, transitioning its lifecycle `status` from `active` to `archived`. Archived subdirectories cannot be used as download targets. Returns the updated subdirectory record. Raises FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not under the active settings), and FAILED_PRECONDITION if the subdirectory is not currently `active`.

id.description: Primary key of the subdirectory to archive.

tool_schemas.name: list_download_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists download job audit records under the active download settings, optionally filtered by `status`, `subdirectory`, and/or `source_url`. Results are paged. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `subdirectory` is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the specified `subdirectory` does not exist, FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED/TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when reads are rate-limited.

subdirectory.description: Optional managed subdirectory name to filter jobs by.

source_url.description: Optional source URL filter (exact match after normalization).

page_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_download_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single download job by `id` and returns its current status and audit details. Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist (or is not visible under the active settings), FAILED_PRECONDITION if no download root is configured, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller cannot view download history.

id.description: Primary key of the download job to fetch.

metadata.name: Markdown Downloader
